ns2:course.label: Geographies of Global Conflict
ns2:course.description: Focuses on contemporary cultural conflicts, competition among nations for economic and mineral resources; treats territorial disputes from a cultural and geographic perspective. Case studies vary to illustrate types of contemporary conflicts. Same as GLBL 221. Credit is not given for GGIS 221 and GGIS 110.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Same as GLBL 221. Credit is not given for GGIS 221 and GGIS 110.
ns2:course.sectionDegreeAttributes: Social & Beh Sci - Soc Sci course.
ns2:course.classScheduleInformation: Students must register for the lecture and one discussion section.
